title: Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting 2025
description: Attended the Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting as one of Hong Kong's young scientists — the world's premier gathering of scientific excellence. Fewer than 600 young scientists worldwide are invited each year.

title: Shaw Laureates Roundtable 2025
description: Academic Representative at the Shaw Laureates Roundtable — the Asian equivalent of the Nobel Prize — engaging directly with laureates in life science, astronomy, and mathematics.

title: RPG Forum — Speaker 2025
description: Attended as a Young Scientist — connecting emerging researchers with Nobel, Turing, and Fields Medal laureates. One of fewer than 200 scientists invited globally per cohort.

title: Drug Discovery Speaker 2025
description: Invited speaker on computational drug discovery at the Hong Kong–Jiangsu Symposium, bridging academia and industry in molecular simulation.

title: 2nd GBA Cryo-EM Frontier Forum — Speaker 2025
description: Speaker at the 2nd Greater Bay Area Cryo-EM Frontier Forum, presenting on structural biology and molecular simulation approaches.

title: SPSAS Attendee 2025
description: Selected attendee at the São Paulo Advanced Science School, an elite international training programme for early-career researchers.

title: CAS Future Leaders Programme
description: Participated in the Chinese Academy of Sciences Future Leaders programme — one of the most prestigious early-career programmes by China's national academy of science, with over 60,000 researchers.
